ClientName.description: Client name for the registered AI provider.

ProviderName.description: Legacy alias of ClientName, read when ClientName is missing.

AuthenticationType.description: Alias copied to Properties.AuthenticationType. Supported by AzureSpeech deployments.

ApiKey.description: Alias copied as given to Properties.ApiKey. It must be the protected value (see Properties.ApiKey); a key in clear text does not work.

IdentityId.description: Alias copied to Properties.IdentityId: the managed identity client ID of an AzureSpeech deployment.

Endpoint.description: Contained-connection endpoint. Required by AzureSpeech deployments; an optional absolute address that replaces the provider's default for ElevenLabs and Cartesia deployments.

ApiKey.description: Contained-connection API key (AzureSpeech, ElevenLabs and Cartesia deployments), stored protected with the 'AIProviderConnection' data protection purpose. The value is read as a protected value when the deployment is used, so a key in clear text does not work: keep the protected value an exported plan carries (it only decrypts on a site that shares the exporting site's data protection keys), or leave it out and enter the key on the deployment in the admin.

IdentityId.description: Optional client ID of a user-assigned managed identity. Used when AuthenticationType is ManagedIdentity.

items.description: Technical name of a registered model feature the underlying model was trained with, for example textGeneration, toolCalling, reasoning, imageInput, audioInput, or realtime.

Features.description: Technical names of the trained model features this deployment supports. Only declared features are offered in editors and sent to the provider.

AllowedValues.description: Subset of the registered allowed values this deployment supports. Omit or leave empty to support every registered value.

DefaultValue.description: Value applied when an operator does not select one.

Minimum.description: Inclusive minimum accepted value for numeric parameters.

Maximum.description: Inclusive maximum accepted value for numeric parameters.

additionalProperties.description: Per-deployment narrowing of a registered model parameter.

Parameters.description: Supported model parameters keyed by their registered technical name (for example reasoningEffort). A parameter that is not present is not exposed by the deployment.

SpeechToTextDeploymentName.description: Technical name of the deployment that transcribes the user's speech. Must expose a realtime client.

ChatDeploymentName.description: Technical name of the chat deployment that generates the reply.

TextToSpeechDeploymentName.description: Technical name of the deployment that speaks the reply.

CascadedRealtimeMetadata.description: Set on a deployment created under the CascadedRealtime client to chain a speech-to-text, a chat, and a text-to-speech deployment into one realtime deployment.

Currency.description: The ISO currency code the prices are in, such as USD. Defaults to USD.

Meter.description: The billed unit. Cached, cache-write, audio, and image tokens are taken out of the input and output tokens when they have their own price.

Amount.description: What Per units cost, in the pricing's currency.

Per.description: How many of the meter's base units Amount pays for, such as 1000000 for a price per million tokens, or 60 for a price per minute of audio (AudioSeconds).

CountName.description: For the AdditionalCount meter: the name of the count the provider reports, as shown in the usage report.

AboveInputTokens.description: Long-context price: applies instead of the meter's regular price to requests with more input tokens than this.

Increment.description: Rounds each request's quantity up to a multiple of this many base units, such as 15 for audio billed in 15-second increments. 0 bills the exact quantity.

Prices.description: The prices, one per billed unit. Several prices for the same meter add up.

SpeakingRate.description: How fast the profile speaks, as a multiple of the voice's normal pace (1 is normal), clamped to 0.25-4. Null uses the deployment's own pace.

Text.description: The word or phrase to pronounce differently.

MatchCase.description: Whether Text matches only with the same letter case.

PronunciationEntries.description: Pronunciation replacements applied before text is spoken.

BoostedKeywords.description: Words the speech recognizer is biased toward, such as product names.

RecognitionLanguages.description: Languages the recognizer should expect, as BCP-47 tags. The first is the primary language.

InterruptionSensitivity.description: How readily the caller's speech interrupts the assistant, from 0 (never interrupted) to 1 (any caller speech interrupts it). Null uses the default.

Properties.description: Source-specific resource metadata grouped by metadata object name. Known built-in metadata objects are FtpConnectionMetadata and SftpConnectionMetadata, and extra objects are allowed for future resource sources.

FtpConnectionMetadata.description: Known FTP connection settings for ftp:// MCP resources. Additional properties are allowed for provider-specific extensions.

Host.description: FTP or FTPS server host name.

Port.description: Optional FTP server port. Common defaults are 21 for FTP and 990 for implicit FTPS.

Username.description: Username used to authenticate to the FTP server.

Password.description: Password used to authenticate to the FTP server. Recipe exports may sanitize this value.

EncryptionMode.description: FTP encryption mode. Use None for plain FTP, Explicit or Implicit for FTPS, or Auto to let the client decide.

DataConnectionType.description: FTP data channel mode used for directory listings and file transfers.

ValidateAnyCertificate.description: Whether to accept any SSL/TLS certificate, including self-signed certificates.

ReadTimeout.description: Read timeout in seconds for FTP operations.

RetryAttempts.description: How many times failed FTP operations should be retried.

SftpConnectionMetadata.description: Known SFTP connection settings for sftp:// MCP resources. Additional properties are allowed for provider-specific extensions.

Port.description: Optional SFTP server port. The usual default is 22.

Username.description: Username used to authenticate to the SFTP server.

Password.description: Password used for SFTP password authentication. Recipe exports may sanitize this value.

PrivateKey.description: Private key payload used for SFTP key-based authentication. Recipe exports may sanitize this value.

Passphrase.description: Optional passphrase for the private key. Recipe exports may sanitize this value.

ProxyType.description: Optional proxy type used when the SFTP server is reached through a proxy.

ProxyHost.description: Proxy host name when ProxyType is not None.

ProxyPort.description: Proxy port when ProxyType is not None.

ProxyPassword.description: Optional proxy password. Recipe exports may sanitize this value.

KeepAliveInterval.description: Optional keep-alive interval in seconds to keep idle SFTP sessions active.

Resources.description: The MCP resources to create or update.

AIVisitorIdentityOptionsSchema.description: Configuration for anonymous AI chat visitor identity and remote-address handling.

CookieName.description: The cookie name used to persist the anonymous visitor identifier.

CookieLifetime.description: The visitor cookie lifetime as a .NET TimeSpan string.

AllowCrossSiteEmbedding.description: Whether the visitor cookie is written SameSite=None; Secure so it survives inside a frame on another site. A request that did not arrive over HTTPS keeps the SameSite=Lax cookie either way.

UsePartitionedCookie.description: Whether the visitor cookie carries the Partitioned attribute while AllowCrossSiteEmbedding is on, which keeps the cookie written in a frame apart from the first-party one of the same name.

RemoteAddressHashSalt.description: The application-specific salt used when hashing remote addresses.

PromptSecurityOptionsSchema.description: Configuration for AI chat prompt security and abuse throttling.

MaxPromptLength.description: The maximum allowed prompt length in characters.

EnableInjectionDetection.description: Whether prompt injection detection is enabled.

EnableSecurityPreamble.description: Whether the hardened security preamble is enabled.

EnableInputDelimiters.description: Whether user input delimiters are enabled.

EnableChatInteractionInputDelimiters.description: Whether user messages in Chat Interactions are wrapped with boundary delimiters. Chat Interactions get no security preamble or injection blocking.

EnableAuditLogging.description: Whether security audit logging is enabled.

BlockingThreshold.description: The minimum prompt risk level that triggers blocking, after weighted scoring.

LowRiskScoreThreshold.description: The aggregate score from which a prompt is suspicious (low risk).

MediumRiskScoreThreshold.description: The aggregate score from which a prompt is medium risk.

HighRiskScoreThreshold.description: The aggregate score from which a prompt is high risk.

CriticalRiskScoreThreshold.description: The aggregate score from which a prompt is critical risk.

CustomBlockedPatterns.description: Extra regular expressions detected in user prompts. A match scores as critical and is blocked by the default thresholds.

MaxMessagesPerWindow.description: The maximum number of messages allowed within the rate-limit window.

RateLimitWindow.description: The chat message rate-limit window as a .NET TimeSpan string.

AnonymousMessageRateLimitTiers.description: The multi-tier sliding-window message limits applied to anonymous callers. A message is throttled when it would exceed any tier. When empty, anonymous callers fall back to MaxMessagesPerWindow and RateLimitWindow.

Limit.description: The maximum number of events allowed within the window.

Window.description: The sliding-window duration as a .NET TimeSpan string.

MaxAnonymousSessionsPerWindow.description: The maximum number of anonymous sessions allowed within the anonymous session-start window. Used only as a fallback when AnonymousSessionStartRateLimitTiers is empty.

AnonymousSessionRateLimitWindow.description: The anonymous session-start rate-limit window as a .NET TimeSpan string.

AnonymousSessionStartRateLimitTiers.description: The multi-tier sliding-window limits applied to anonymous session starts. A session start is throttled when it would exceed any tier. When empty, anonymous session starts fall back to MaxAnonymousSessionsPerWindow and AnonymousSessionRateLimitWindow.

Limit.description: The maximum number of events allowed within the window.

Window.description: The sliding-window duration as a .NET TimeSpan string.
